claims: improves risk-adjusted returns across various asset classes
equity-like returns with bond-like volatility and drawdown

a-quantitative-approach-to-tactical-asse.finding: A moving-average timing model, tested in-sample on US equities and out-of-sample on more than twenty other markets, then in an allocation across five asset classes since 1972, gives equity-like returns with bond-like volatility and drawdown.
a-quantitative-approach-to-tactical-asse.title: A Quantitative Approach to Tactical Asset Allocation
